title: Mark Q6 Ronaldo and You as correct (multi-correct) while preserving /7 scoring

requirements.summary: Update Q6 quiz data so both “Ronaldo” and “You” are treated as correct answers and trigger normal correct-answer scoring and celebration behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/features/quiz/quizData.ts, Q6 option "Ronaldo" has isCorrect: true and option "You" has isCorrect: true (while "Myself" and "Food" remain isCorrect: false).
Selecting "Ronaldo" on Q6 increments the score by 1 and triggers the correct-answer celebration effects.
Selecting "You" on Q6 increments the score by 1 and triggers the correct-answer celebration effects.
Selecting "Myself" or "Food" on Q6 does not increment the score and does not trigger the correct-answer celebration effects.
Overall quiz total remains 7 questions; score display and result branching continue to use /7 scoring.

file_operations.description: Set Q6 ("Which thing do I love the most?") option "You" to isCorrect: true while keeping "Ronaldo" as isCorrect: true and leaving "Myself" and "Food" as isCorrect: false, so the existing correct-answer scoring and celebration logic treats selecting either correct option as correct.
